goal: Prevent debug builds from aborting when receiving malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests
Return spec-compliant error replies instead of HTTP 400 errors or silently dropping invalid notifications
agreement: Strong support for adhering to the JSON-RPC 2.0 specification and fixing the crash (ryanofsky, hodlinator)
Verified by testing malformed single requests and invalid batch elements (fametrano)
Objection on batch notification consistency resolved along with dead code removal (ryanofsky, hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it fixes an assertion abort in debug builds triggered by malformed 2.0 requests
It stops invalid requests missing an id from being silently discarded as notifications
